preferences.autonomous_troubleshooting: if it doesnt run, fix the issue — wants autonomous fixes, not questions
preferences.push_restrictions: i dont want you to push anything — never push to remote without explicit permission
preferences.architecture_style: wants cleaner architecture for open-source readiness (modular, contributor-friendly)
preferences.git_preference: prefers to track only specific files in git, not entire directories

workloads.hardware_sensitivity: runs local LLM inference, needs extra hardware — avoids reserved resources (no Colima VM)
workloads.colima_replacement_goal: wants to replace Colima with apple/container + stevedore to avoid hardware reservation

project.name: stevedore
project.tech_stack: Node.js, MIT licensed, modular command handlers via dispatcher pattern
project.purpose: docker CLI shim → apple/container CLI (runs containers on Apple Silicon with zero overhead, no persistent VM)
project.architecture: dispatcher routes subcommands to src/commands/*.js handlers; handlers use exec() to spawn container binary

key_constraints.testcontainers_java: cannot use stevedore directly — Testcontainers Java needs Docker Engine API socket, not CLI
key_constraints.apple_container_limitation: apple/container does not expose a Docker-compatible API socket for docker-java to talk to
key_constraints.mvp_approach: build a Docker API shim/emulator that translates Engine API calls to apple/container CLI commands

learned.apple_container_is_cli_only: apple/container has no Docker Engine API socket — API clients like Testcontainers Java require a proxy/shim layer, not just a CLI shim
learned.stevedore_dispatcher_pattern: src/commands/*.js exports default async function(args); dispatcher routes subcommands; handlers call exec() which spawns container binary via child_process.spawn()
learned.socktainer_pattern: Swift + Vapor server listening on Unix socket, implements Docker API v1.51, uses per-endpoint RouteCollection structs, versioned regex routes for API compatibility

conventions.command_surface: User-facing workflow should stay as docker commands (`docker ...`) routed through this codebase; `stevedore` is for diagnostics/meta commands like `stevedore doctor`.
conventions.no_docker_desktop_goal: Stevedore is intended to avoid Docker Desktop/Colima by translating docker CLI semantics to apple/container.

failure_lessons.correction_docker_vs_stevedore: Assistant initially changed behavior to wrap docker directly or shifted command surfaces inconsistently. User clarified repeatedly: normal commands must be invoked as docker commands, translated to apple/container, with stevedore reserved for doctor/meta.
failure_lessons.tool_quirk_container_path: Hardcoding /usr/local/bin/container failed on Apple Silicon (ENOENT). Use /opt/homebrew/bin/container fallback or resolve via `command -v container`.
failure_lessons.insight_testcontainers: Testcontainers requires a Docker Engine API-compatible Unix socket; CLI command translation alone is insufficient. A socket/API shim is required.

reference_project.name: swift-test-containers (Mongey)
reference_project.relevance: has AppleContainerClient that wraps container CLI — useful reference for building the API shim layer
reference_project.key_patterns: ContainerRequest builder, ContainerRuntime protocol, scoped lifecycle with cleanup, ContainerState, ContainerInspection, ContainerListItem, parseAppleInspect, toContainerInspection mapping

reference_project_2.name: socktainer
reference_project_2.relevance: Docker Engine API shim for apple/container — the actual pattern to follow for the API socket layer
reference_project_2.tech_stack: Swift + Vapor + NIO, implements Docker API v1.51
reference_project_2.key_patterns: Unix socket at ~/.socktainer/container.sock, Vapor route collections per endpoint, versioned regex routes, health check ping route, container create/start/inspect routes, DockerConnectionState for I/O concurrency, events streaming, info route mapping, BuildKit/image/volume/network/registry service clients, CLI bootstrap with --check-compatibility flag
